description: WDFW-Bonneville Dam observations is a dataset listed in State of Washington open data portal (data.wa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Washington. Visual observations of Chinook salmon ascending fish ladders at Bonneville Dam by ecotype (Bright and Tule) and size class (Jack, Stubby, and Adult) conducted during approximately 1-hour counting periods midday from August through October. Coverage: Washington State. The portal files it under the category Natural Resources & Environment. Its tags are salmon, chinook. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-wa-gov-portal.
